rail.aboutBody: Each card saves independently. Changes apply to the next {{hireOrder}} generated for this organization, not to documents already issued.

hireOrdersTab.disabled: {{HireOrders}} are not enabled for this organization. Contact your ShowFlow administrator to enable the module.

countersignCard.title: Countersign mode
countersignCard.description: How the {{artist}}'s signature is captured once the {{hireOrder}} is issued.
countersignCard.loadError: Could not load the countersign settings.

letterheadCard.title: Letterhead
letterheadCard.description: Appears at the top of every {{hireOrder}} PDF alongside the Hiring party block.
letterheadCard.loadError: Could not load the letterhead settings.
letterheadCard.signatureUploaded: Signature uploaded. Save the letterhead to apply.
letterheadCard.agentSignatureHelp: A PNG of the booking agent's signature, drawn on the signature line of issued {{hireOrders}}. Save the letterhead to apply.
letterheadCard.legalNameRequired: Add the legal name to save. It is the one field no {{hireOrder}} can be issued without.

numberingCard.title: Numbering
numberingCard.description: Controls the number stamped on every {{hireOrder}}. Supported tokens: {prefix}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {dd}, {mmdd}, {seq}, {cast}, {cast|seq}.
numberingCard.loadError: Could not load the numbering settings.

orderDefaultsCard.title: {{HireOrder}} defaults
orderDefaultsCard.description: Prefills a new {{hireOrder}}'s fee, basis, and currency. A per-{{showDate}} fee is multiplied by the number of engagement {{showDates}} on the {{hireOrder}}. {{roleProducer}} can always adjust it per {{hireOrder}}.

pdfTemplateCard.title: PDF template
pdfTemplateCard.description: Wording, fonts, sizes, and colours for the {{hireOrder}} PDF. Edit any element and see the document update as you type. Changes apply to the next {{hireOrder}} issued, not to documents already issued.
pdfTemplateCard.loadError: Could not load the PDF template settings.

termsVariantsCard.title: Terms
termsVariantsCard.description: Templates of clauses printed on the {{hireOrder}} PDF. Each {{hireOrder}} picks one template when it is issued, and one template is marked as the default. ShowFlow ships no default clauses, so your organization authors its own.
termsVariantsCard.loadError: Could not load the terms settings.
termsVariantsCard.noClauses: No clauses yet. Add the clauses your organization wants printed on a "{{label}}" {{hireOrder}} before issuing one.
termsVariantsCard.startFromTemplateHelp: Add a ready-made template to this organization. You own the copy, so editing it here changes nothing for anyone else.
termsVariantsCard.noTemplates: No templates yet. Add one to start authoring terms.

countersignFields.electronicBody: The {{artist}} reviews and signs the issued {{hireOrder}} in the app. Signature, timestamp and IP are stored with it.
countersignFields.manualBody: {{roleProducer}} marks the {{hireOrder}} countersigned once the {{artist}} has signed elsewhere.
countersignFields.emailProducersBody: When the {{artist}} signs, email the assigned {{roleProducer}} a copy. {{roleProducer}} is notified in-app either way.
